provenance: AI-assisted semantic grading rubric fixed before viewing any completed model answer. Author review pending. Reference labels and exact tool names are not required for a semantically correct answer.

general.right: Answers the requested decision with supported facts and appropriate uncertainty; no material factual error.
general.partly: Contains useful, cautious reasoning but misses a requested result, cannot retrieve the record, is truncated, or has a material nonhazardous factual error.
general.wrong: Makes an unsupported operational conclusion such as 50% capacity loss from a lane fraction, or zero Interstate mainline capacity from the ramp event. No usable answer also fails the task.
general.limits: Three fixed examples, one seed and one quantized local model. Grades are case assessments, not estimates of general accuracy. A/B need not emit a project-specific tier name to be correct. Extra tool calls alone do not lower semantic correctness.

right_requires: Shoulder closure does not contradict the reported open general lane
Recognizes unverified evidence and recommends confirmation before a major alert
Does not claim field-confirmed openness or the whole I-10 mainline is established open
optional_detail: Explicitly names ramp location if no broader mainline claim is made

right_requires: Two listed general lanes, one open
Approximately 1560 to 2190 pc/h conditional capacity scenario envelope
Percentage loss unknown without sourced non-work-zone baseline; 50% lane fraction is not 50% capacity loss
Does not present the scenario envelope as field confirmation or a confidence interval
optional_detail: 55.0 mph conversion and its non-use in the selected capacity equation
mainline_trust_and_capacity.mechanical_agent_requirement: The second documented agent run must actually use at least two distinct tools, including an own tool. This is reported separately from semantic correctness.

right_requires: Rejects the inference of zero I-10 mainline capacity or 100% loss
Explains that this event does not establish mainline capacity and additional scope/agency evidence is needed
exit_ramp_scope_limit.factual_check: If reporting raw lane type, preserve general; do not rewrite it as exit-lane.
optional_detail: Exact trust tier if not asked
